trips.status: Live recheck 28 Nov 2026 around 12:15 WIB: all KAI trains re-priced and seat-checked on booking.kai.id for 4-6 Dec; exec bus re-verified on tiket.com for 4 Dec. Still sold out: Progo 300 on 4 Dec, Progo 299 on 6 Dec, Taksaka 33 regular on 6 Dec, Bengawan. Selling down: Taksaka 34 and 32 on 4 Dec (8 kursi left each), Senja Utama exec. New finds: Jayakarta 290 out Rp340k and Jayakarta 289 back Rp240k (cheapest live train pair), Singasari 149 seats back on 5 Dec, Batavia 125 economy Rp380k to Gambir. Sleeper bus, shuttle, return bus and flights NOT rechecked today - those fares are estimates from 26 Nov or a route listing.

tips: Cheapest live train pair (28 Nov): Jayakarta 290 out on 4 Dec (Pasar Senen 17:15, arr 00:45, Rp340k) + Jayakarta 289 back on 5 Dec (19:05, home 03:11, Rp240k) = about Rp580k, no hotel. Both Tersedia.
Progo is still sold out on both 4 and 6 Dec. Bengawan (Rp74k) sold out too. Taksaka 34 and 32 on 4 Dec are down to 8 seats each - if you want the Taksaka overnight, buy soon.
Singasari 149 on 5 Dec has seats again (economy Rp360k, was sold out on 26 Nov). Batavia 125 economy Rp380k overnight to Gambir is another cheap way home.
Bus and shuttle fares other than the 4 Dec exec bus are from 26 Nov and not rechecked today. Flight fares are from a tiket.com route listing and not date-checked - treat both as estimates.

Flying only makes sense if you value the 1h10 flight over the transfer: YIA is 40+ km from Jogja (train to Tugu Rp20k-50k, taxi Rp200k-280k). With transfers it costs more than Taksaka and takes similar total time.
